verdict.rationale: Drata's own API documents multi-framework management: listing frameworks, creating custom frameworks with their own requirements, and mapping and comparing control requirements. This implies several frameworks can run from one platform, but the evidence never names HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as supported frameworks. missing for 10: explicit evidence that HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS are supported out of the box, documentation of cross-framework control reuse in practice, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: List Frameworks ... Create Custom Framework ... List Framework Requirements ... Create Framework Requirements
Create Control ... Reset Control Requirement Mappings ... Compare Control Requirements
